brief: Our 4-stage launch system that consistently hits #1 of the day — visual flowchart.

slots.title: Viral Launch System
slots.subtitle: Our proven four-stage framework that consistently ranks number one.
slots.check1: Positions you as a trusted expert, not just another seller.
slots.check2: Builds momentum before release so sales surge instantly.
slots.check3: Turns first-day buyers into long-term community advocates.

slots.title: The Four Stages
slots.subtitle: Every number-one launch follows this exact same repeatable sequence.
slots.check1: Removes guesswork from your entire product release timeline.
slots.check2: Aligns your team around clear weekly milestones and metrics.
slots.check3: Creates compounding interest before your offer even opens.
slots.takeawayBody: Success is sequential; skip a stage and the launch collapses.

slots.title: Build The Hype
slots.subtitle: Start sixty days out by growing a qualified waitlist daily.
slots.check1: Share valuable teardowns that prove your deep expertise.
slots.check2: Post behind-the-scenes content to build curiosity and trust.
slots.check3: Collect emails with a high-value free bonus resource.
slots.takeawayBody: A packed waitlist guarantees sales the moment your cart opens.

slots.title: Test With Insiders
slots.subtitle: Invite a small group to buy early and share feedback.
slots.check1: Limit the beta cohort to create urgency and exclusivity.
slots.check2: Gather testimonials you can use in the final campaign.
slots.check3: Fix friction points before the public launch day arrives.
slots.takeawayBody: Real proof beats promises; early buyers become your best marketers.

slots.title: Maximize Day One
slots.subtitle: Open the cart publicly with a structured three-day email sprint.
slots.check1: Send emails that educate, then ask for the sale.
slots.check2: Use deadline timers to drive immediate action and urgency.
slots.check3: Leverage testimonials from your soft launch to erase objections.
slots.takeawayBody: Concentrated energy on day one triggers platform algorithms and rankings.

slots.title: Automate The Growth
slots.subtitle: Convert the launch funnel into an automated evergreen sales machine.
slots.check1: Repurpose top-performing posts into ads that run year-round.
slots.check2: Build email automations that nurture new subscribers into buyers.
slots.check3: Add upsells that increase average order value on autopilot.
slots.takeawayBody: One launch fuels perpetual revenue when the backend is automated.

slots.title: Why It Works
slots.subtitle: This system stacks every advantage in your favor before launch.
slots.check1: Audience priming creates demand instead of chasing cold traffic.
slots.check2: Social proof from beta buyers removes all purchase friction.
slots.check3: Urgency and scarcity drive immediate action at every stage.
slots.takeawayBody: Launches fail from silence, not product flaws; this fixes that.

slots.body: Save this carousel and follow these four stages for your next release. Consistency always beats perfection.
